underground printmaker, timeless folkloric, rendered as voxel concept art moodboard, a desaturated Nordic palette, corrugated metal

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Lighting reference: underlighting from a translucent base panel.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
